QuestInfo.name: The Hut in the Swamp
QuestInfo.0: Ryden wasn't satisfied with the results of the previous investigation, so he's starting a new one. Find out what this is about.
QuestInfo.1:
Ryden had the #b#m103030100##k checked and confirmed that the Dark Lord meets with someone in the Hut in the Swamp.

He could have allies... You need to investigate the #bHut in the Swamp#k. Pay extra attention to the #bHut's Trash Can#k.

#i4033182##t4033182#  #b#c4033182#/1#k
QuestInfo.2: You encountered a Dark Disciple in the hut and took care of him. You gave the document he dropped to Ryden, who is now angry because it turns out the Dark Lord is investigating Lady Syl!

0.0: Well, the Delivery Package investigation was a bust, but something'll turn up sooner or later. It has to, with the Dark Lord being who he is. Now, on to our other lead...
0.1: I've had the #b#m103030100##k watched recently, based on what we learned--do you think she's single, by the way?--and we've discovered the Dark Lord meets with someone in the #bHut in the Swamp#k.
0.2: Is he meeting with potential allies? Head to the Hut in the Swamp and find out. Trust me, it'll be easy.

yes.0: While you're in the Hut in the Swamp, pay attention to any potential hiding places, like behind paintings or in #bTrash Cans#k. Never hurts to poke around.

1.0: So the Dark Lord was rendezvousing with Dark Disciples... Let's see that document you retrieved.

yes.0: Why, this document shows that the Dark Lord has been investigating Lady Syl! He has some nerve.

item.0: You still haven't gone to the #bHut in the Swamp#k? You can find the Hut in the Swamp at #b#m103030100##k. It'll be easy.
